Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check first: are story 3 and story 4 done, is task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12?  
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page work that’s waiting on the idempotency keys?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, for story 5 you said “I’ll chase it today,” and for bug 12 you said “I’ll pair with him on the staging access today” — are those done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Who can help unblock bug 12, with the sandbox gateway timeouts and access to the platform team’s staging gateway?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and commitment: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I’ll chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Thanks, Maya. Admin, is story 1 done, and is task 14 done? What have you finished, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted you finished the refund API tests, you’re working on the payment retry story, and there are no blockers.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock the task that slipped because the sandbox was down?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the commitment: Sync with Maya after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: Maya is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway, and the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review. A side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin about gateway timeouts was parked for offline follow-up. One flagged item was not covered: task 15 is stale, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thank you, everyone.
